alt: 學生指責一旁驚訝的同學，自己卻把球藏在背後，目擊者看著球和地上的碎花瓶。
scene_prompt: In a school art room, a dishonest student points accusingly at an innocent classmate beside a broken vase. The innocent classmate has empty hands and a shocked expression. The accuser hides the ball that caused the accident behind their own back; a nearby witness clearly sees the concealed ball, and fresh scattered shards lie along its path. Make false blame and actual culprit unmistakable. No blood, no speech bubbles.
